description.zh: Todoist 的只读镜像：列出所有未完成的任务，带优先级圆点与到期日；没有账号时它就是一个本地草稿本。非官方组件，与 Todoist 无关联、未获其支持。
description.en: A read-only mirror of Todoist: every open task with its priority dot and due date. Without an account it doubles as a local scratch list. Not created by, affiliated with, or supported by Todoist.

items.zh: 按「打开 Todoist 设置页」，在「集成 → 开发者」里复制 API token，粘进输入框。它只存进本机密封库，不落组件存储。
items.en: Press Open the Todoist settings page, copy the API token under Integrations → Developer, and paste it in. It goes into the local sealed store only.

items.zh: 这个组件不是 Todoist 做的，也没得到它的支持 —— 数据来自 Todoist 的公开接口，接口变了这里会跟着坏。
items.en: This widget is not made or supported by Todoist. It reads Todoist's public API, so when that API changes, this breaks with it.

items.zh: 换 Windows 账户或重装系统之后要重新填：密封库绑的是当前这个账户。底栏的齿轮里可以断开。
items.en: After switching Windows accounts or reinstalling, paste it again — the sealed store is tied to this account. Disconnect lives behind the gear in the footer.

title.zh: 这是镜像，不是第二份清单
title.en: A mirror, not a second list

items.zh: 连上之后卡片只读：勾选、新增、改期都在 Todoist 里做。这里看到什么，Todoist 里就是什么。
items.en: Once connected the card is read-only: tick, add and reschedule in Todoist. What you see here is what Todoist has.

items.zh: 每十分钟对一次；卡片不可见时不发请求。底栏写着上次同步的时间。
items.en: It syncs every ten minutes, and never while the card is hidden. The footer shows when it last synced.

items.zh: 只列未完成的任务。任务多的时候只画前 40 条，标题里写「40+ 项」—— 那个加号是真的没画完。
items.en: Only open tasks. Past 40 rows it stops and the header reads 40+ — that plus means the rest is not drawn.

items.zh: 没连 Todoist 时，它是一个本地草稿本：加一条、点一下勾掉、× 删掉。数据按组件存在本机。
items.en: Without Todoist it is a local scratch list: add one, click a row to tick it, × to delete. It is stored on this machine, per widget.

items.zh: 草稿本永远不会推到 Todoist —— 它没有同步这回事。勾掉的留在列表里划线，再点一下放回。
items.en: The scratch list never gets pushed to Todoist — there is no sync here. Ticked rows stay, struck through; click again to undo.

items.zh: 连上 Todoist 之后草稿本会收起来，内容留着；断开就又能看到。想要一个正经的本地待办，装「待办」那个组件。
items.en: Connecting hides the scratch list but keeps it — disconnect to see it again. For a real local to-do list, install the Todo widget instead.

items.zh: 圆点对应 Todoist 的优先级：红 p1、黄 p2、绿 p3；空心圈是 p4，也就是没设。
items.en: Dots follow Todoist priority: red p1, amber p2, green p3; an empty circle is p4, which means none.

items.zh: 右边是到期日，过期的画成红色。没有到期日的行不写日期。
items.en: The right column is the due date, in red once it is past. Rows without a due date show nothing.

items.zh: 「token 失效了」：在 Todoist 里重置过 token，或者粘错了一截。按齿轮换一个。
items.en: Token is no longer valid: it was reset in Todoist, or pasted incompletely. Use the gear to replace it.

items.zh: 「被限流了」：短时间请求太多。它会把要等的秒数写出来（来自 Retry-After）。
items.en: Rate-limited: too many requests in a short window. It prints how long to wait, from Retry-After.

items.zh: 连不上时列表不会清空 —— 画的是上次成功的那一份，时间就在那句话后面。
items.en: When it cannot connect the list is kept — it is the last good copy, and the footer shows its time.

changes.zh: 改名「Todoist 待办」并加免责声明：这个组件不是 Todoist 做的，也没得到它的支持。
changes.en: Renamed to Tasks for Todoist and added a disclaimer: this widget is not made or supported by Todoist.

changes.zh: 没有 Todoist 账号也能用：本地草稿本，能加、能勾、能删，只在没连 Todoist 时出现。
changes.en: Works without a Todoist account now: a local scratch list you can add to, tick and delete, shown only while disconnected.

changes.zh: 填 token 那一屏多了一颗「打开 Todoist 设置页」，少找两步。
changes.en: The token screen gained an Open the Todoist settings page button, saving two steps.

changes.zh: 连上之后如果本地还有几条，会说一次它们留在本机、不会同步。
changes.en: If local items exist when you connect, it says once that they stay on this machine and are not synced.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：只读列出 Todoist 里所有未完成的任务，带优先级圆点、到期日与过期标记。
changes.en: First release: every open Todoist task, read-only, with priority dots, due dates and overdue marks.

changes.zh: token 走平台的密封库，不进组件存储；填一次，重启还在。
changes.en: The token goes into the platform's sealed store, not widget storage — paste it once and it survives restarts.

changes.zh: 断网或限流时保留上一次的列表，底栏说清楚是哪一种。
changes.en: Offline or rate-limited keeps the previous list, and the footer says which one it was.
